row: Hi! My name is Dr. Susan Bonilla, MS, CVA, CCRP.  I am certified in both veterinary acupuncture and canine rehabilitation therapy.  Here you will find a selection of some of the most amazing dog and cat patients I have had the privilege of helping, improving their quality of life and well being through acupuncture and rehabilitation.
